ei.title: The Uniqueness of Human Collective Morality
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Is morality unique to human beings? Not entirely. Other species seem to have some understanding of fairness, especially when one individual's rights or wishes have been thwarted. Only human beings seem to have morality based in the collectivity, however. As social psychologist Jonathan Haidt pointed out, only human beings show "widespread third party norm enforcement." That is, people will expend their own or community resources to fight immorality even if they were not themselves the victims. They seem to recognize that maintaining morality is a generally good thing even when they are not directly affected. No other animal does this. If one dog steals a bone from another dog, the loser may protest and may even be said to have some moral sense that the stealing was wrong. But you will not see a third dog intervene to force the first dog to return the bone to the second. Only cultural animals use morality as a property of the larger society.

questions.passage: Is morality unique to human beings? Not entirely. Only human beings seem to have morality based in the (B)[collectivity / individuality], however. As social psychologist Jonathan Haidt pointed out, only human beings show "widespread third party norm enforcement." That is, people will expend their own or community resources to fight immorality even if they were not themselves the (C)[victims / beneficiaries]. They seem to recognize that maintaining morality is a generally good thing even when they are not directly affected. No other animal does this. If one dog steals a bone from another dog, the loser may protest and may even be said to have some moral sense that the stealing was wrong. But you will not see a third dog intervene to force the first dog to return the bone to the second. Only cultural animals use morality as a property of the larger society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ fairness - collectivity - victims = 원문 일치
❌ ① cruelty: 공정함이 아닌 '잔인함'은 맥락 부적절
❌ ② individuality: 집단이 아닌 '개별성'은 원문과 반대
❌ ④ 세 단어 모두 원문과 불일치

④ force: 첫 번째 개에게 강제하다 → 적절

Only cultural animals use morality as ____.
✅ ③ a property of the larger society: 더 큰 사회의 속성 = 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ① some moral sense: 도덕적 감각 (개별 동물 맥락)
❌ ② community resources: 공동체 자원 (싸우다 맥락)
❌ ④ third party norm enforcement: 제3자 규범 집행 (인용구 내 표현)
